# Source: Battle of the Forces of Krishna and Bana, from a copy of the Dispersed Bhagavat Purana

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Battle of the Forces of Krishna and Bana, from a copy of the Dispersed Bhagavat Purana
- **Artist / culture:** India Delhi-Agra region, possibly Mathura
- **Date:** c. 1520–1530
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** calligraphy
- **Department:** Arts of Asia
- **AIC artwork ID:** 14849
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/14849
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/831534f4-dd88-4100-41b3-0016f19e4d7a/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Calligraphy

## Extracted source palette

`#E8C8A8, #B88868, #B84848, #B87848, #D8A878, #585848, #786858, #987858`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#602525`
- `surface`: `#723E3E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B87848`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8C8A8`
- `surface_variant`: `#723E3E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#8B6060`
- `error`: `#B87848`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.04:1`, surface `7.98:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.98:1`
- Control contrast: `5.41:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
